name: @pipeworx/mcp-metmuseum

tools.name: search_artworks
tools.description: Search The Met's open-access collection by keyword. Optionally filter to objects with images, currently on view, by medium, or by a year range. Returns compact records (title, artist, date, medium, image) hydrated from object detail. Keyless.

limit.description: How many matching objects to hydrate with full detail (default 8, max 15).

has_images.description: Only return objects that have images (default true).

on_view.description: Only return objects currently on view in a gallery.

date_begin.description: Start year of the date range, e.g. 1700. Must be paired with date_end.

date_end.description: End year of the date range, e.g. 1800. Must be paired with date_begin.

tools.name: get_artwork
tools.description: Get the rich detail for a single Met collection object by its objectID — artist bio, medium, dimensions, department, classification, culture, period, credit line, image URLs, tags, and gallery number. Keyless.

tools.name: list_departments
tools.description: List The Met's curatorial departments (e.g. European Paintings, Egyptian Art, Arms and Armor) with their department IDs, usable to scope searches. Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-metmuseum forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the metmuseum pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
